revisions.concept: Close-up: Eli, large and expressive, fills the right half of the frame with an amazed open-mouthed face, holding up a small lit clay oil lamp inside a dark rough rock tunnel; a thin stream of bright blue water runs along the tunnel floor beside him. Simple dark background, clear empty top quarter, no clutter, no lettering.
